flagDetails.HARD_CLASH: Booking #{reference} holds the same room or item hard at this time, so this order can't be confirmed. Move the time or talk to whoever owns #{reference}.
flagDetails.HARD_CLASH_BLOCK: The room or item is blocked on the calendar at this time, for example for maintenance. Move the time or remove the block.

RUN_SHEET.DRAFT: {runSheet} hasn't been sent to the team yet. Open it and send it so they can prepare.
RUN_SHEET.REVISION_PENDING: The order changed after {runSheet} was sent. Send it again so the team works from the latest version.
RUN_SHEET.BLOCKED: {runSheet} can't be sent until what blocks it is fixed. Open it to see what's missing.

flagDetails.HOLD_EXPIRES: The preliminary booking is released {date} unless the order moves on. Confirm it or extend the hold.
flagDetails.QUOTE_WAITING: The customer hasn't answered the quote sent {date}. Follow up or change the quote.
flagDetails.UNREAD_MESSAGES: {count, plural, one {A message on this order hasn't been read.} other {# messages on this order haven't been read.}} Open the order to read and answer.

tasks.UNCONFIRMED: Confirm or release {count, plural, one {# soft hold} other {# soft holds}}
tasks.UNREAD_MESSAGES: Answer {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}

dismiss.label: Dismiss
dismiss.title: Dismiss this task?
dismiss.description: It is hidden for you until something about it changes, such as its due time. Others who get the same task still see it.

hints.RUN_SHEET_BLOCKED: Something stops the run sheet from being sent. Open it to see what is missing.
hints.RUN_SHEET_UNSENT: The run sheet has not been sent, or it has changed since it was sent. Open it and send it.
hints.UNCONFIRMED: Some lines are still soft holds and the order starts soon. Confirm or release them in the program below.
hints.HOLD_EXPIRES: The order's soft holds run out soon. Confirm the lines, or move the date the hold runs until.
hints.UNREAD_MESSAGES: The customer has written and is waiting for an answer.
hints.PAYMENT_OVERDUE: An invoice is past its due date and not fully paid. Contact the customer about the payment.
hints.NOT_CLOSED: Everything on the order has taken place. Pick a status that closes the order in the status menu at the top right.
hints.QUOTE_WAITING: The customer has not answered the quote yet. Get in touch with them, or open the quote to see it.
hints.TASK_DUE: A task on this order is due. Open it and tick it off when it is done.

occupancy.formDescription: Block the item for maintenance or internal use. Bookings and setup time cannot overlap a block.
occupancy.archiveConfirm: Do you want to release the block so the item can be booked again?
occupancy.empty: The item is not occupied from now on.
occupancy.overlap: The item is already occupied during this period.

tabs.emptyPast: Nothing has occupied the item yet.

quote.title: Quote, version {version}
quote.formDescription: Set the validity and the terms. The lines are the order's own: add and price them on the order.
quote.sent: The quote has been marked as sent.
quote.declined: The quote has been marked as declined.
quote.revised: A new version has been created.
quote.restoreTitle: Restore quote v{version} to the order

confirm.send: Mark version {version} as sent to the customer? The order's lines are frozen into it, it can no longer be edited, and older sent versions are marked as replaced. The customer can still choose one of those.
confirm.accept: Record that the customer accepted version {version}? The order moves on if the pipeline has a status for it.
confirm.decline: Record that the customer declined version {version}?
confirm.expire: Expire version {version}? The customer can no longer accept it.
confirm.choose: Record that the customer chose version {version}? The order is restored to what this quote offered and the newer quote is marked declined.

methodRequired.description: Pay links need a connected service that takes payments, such as Stripe or Swish. An administrator connects one under Administration → Integrations; until then these actions are not available.

refund.description: The money goes back to the customer the way it was paid. A payment you recorded yourselves counts as refunded at once; pay the money back outside Bibi.

cancel.title: Cancel the payment?
cancel.confirm: The pay link stops working and the payment is no longer requested. If money still comes in, it is recorded.

recordManual.title: Record payment
recordManual.description: For money you received outside Bibi, such as a bank transfer or cash.

ledger.missing: Connect Fortnox or Spiris to take payments. They make every invoice and deposit invoice, so deposits, invoices and payment links can be created once one is connected.

STRIPE.name: Stripe
STRIPE.description: Card payments and invoices with a pay link, straight to your organization's own Stripe account.

FORTNOX.name: Fortnox
FORTNOX.description: Accounting and invoicing. Invoices are raised in Fortnox, and payments booked there are mirrored back to Bibi.

SWISH.name: Swish
SWISH.description: Swish for merchants: the customer pays in the Swish app, with a QR code on a computer or straight on the phone.

VISMA.name: Spiris (Visma eEkonomi)
VISMA.description: Accounting and invoicing. Invoices are raised in Spiris, and payments booked there are mirrored back to Bibi.
